summary: Configured Fractal web browsers export DOM-changing input-to-paint spans through the existing OTLP trace exporter, with bounded attributes and final painted/coalesced/unacknowledged outcomes.

compatibility.detail: Adds fractal.input.next_frame spans to the existing opt-in browser traces endpoint. No new exporter, dependencies or wire protocol.

manual.detail: No installation action required. Existing VITE_OTLP_TRACES_URL configuration controls export.

recovery.detail: No database or runtime recovery changes.
